title: Promotions
description: Manage featured and sponsored listing promotions.

help.title: About Promotions
help.overview: A promotion boosts one listing as featured or sponsored for a start–end window. Lifecycle status is active, paused, or stopped — changed by actions, not by ordinary edit.

sections.title: Lifecycle
items: Active — the promotion is live within its date window.
Pause — only from active; the boost is held without ending the campaign.
Resume — only from paused, and only if endAt is still in the future.
Stop — ends the promotion permanently and records a stop reason. It cannot be resumed.

sections.title: Ownership
items: Start and end bound when the boost applies.
Soft-deleted promotions are not actionable until restored.
sections.body: Pause, resume, and stop require ownership of the listing (or admin).
